reason: My clients have never asked for this before the house is built, and I bill cost-plus, so I only add a line if the homeowner agrees to pay for it. Their architect already gives them renderings, so I'd be asking them to pay $1,500 for something they don't think they need.
objection: Nobody has ever asked me for this, so I'd be the one trying to sell it to a homeowner who then pays for it on my invoice. At 1-6 homes a year that's a lot of awkward line-item conversations for not much gain.
would_change_my_mind: A homeowner telling me they want it and agreeing in writing to pay for it, or proof it cuts change orders enough to save me real money mid-build.
